source: If a warp’s threads need neighboring 4-byte values, those useful bytes can share a small number of sectors. If the same 32 threads touch addresses spread far apart, the hardware may need many sectors even though the source code still contains one load instruction per thread.
zh: 如果 warp 的线程需要相邻的 4 字节值，这些有用的字节可以共享少量扇区。如果相同的 32 个线程接触的地址分散得很远，则即使源代码每个线程仍然包含一条加载指令，硬件也可能需要许多扇区。
